journey.name: Story Creation Toolkit, Snapping Guides, and Viewer
journey.description: Tests creating a 9:16 story with gradient backdrop, brush drawing, text sticker, emoji sticker, snapping guide toggle, publishing, and viewing it in the Story Viewer.

actions.action: Verify that the 'Snap' snapping guide toggle pill and Story tools ('Backdrop', 'Draw', 'Text', 'Stickers', 'Audio 5s') are visible
Tap the 'Snap' pill to toggle snapping off and verify it changes to 'Snap Off', then tap again to restore 'Snap'
Tap the 'Backdrop' tool and select the 'Ocean' backdrop
Tap the 'Draw' tool, draw a short stroke on the story canvas, and tap undo
Tap the 'Text' tool, enter 'Pier Vibes' into the overlay text field, and tap 'Add'
Tap the 'Stickers' tool and tap a quick emoji sticker to place it on the story canvas
Scroll down and tap the 'Share Story' button
Verify return to the Feed screen and that 'Your Story' ring appears in the stories bar
Tap 'Your Story' in the stories ring bar
Verify that the Story Viewer opens full screen and shows the close button
Tap the close button to return to Feed
